scope.experience: Ordinary conversational assistance in the Gemini app
scope.task: Brainstorm a learning plan and refine a short written draft through follow-up questions.
scope.configuration: Standard text chat with Connected Apps disabled; no mobile-device actions or agentic research. No particular subscription or model was tested.
scope.audience_perspective: A non-specialist individual using standard chat

conversational.rationale: Users can ask open-ended questions, revise prompts and continue a discussion across many topics.
conversational.uncertainty: This describes conversation design, not a measured ability to maintain context indefinitely.

specialization.rationale: Brainstorming, drafting and explanations are general-purpose functions; a single prompted task does not create a specialized product.
specialization.uncertainty: A specific Gem or Workspace integration would merit its own, narrower reference.

autonomy.rationale: Without Connected Apps or device tools, the scoped chat responds to user prompts and leaves external actions to the user.
autonomy.uncertainty: Other Gemini modes can act on files or devices and should not inherit this score.

accessibility.rationale: Everyday language and broadly relevant tasks make the standard app suitable for a wide audience without professional-domain training.
accessibility.uncertainty: Accounts, age eligibility, regions, devices and usage allowances vary; no usability or assistive-technology audit was performed.

explainability.rationale: Prompts, answers and revisions are visible, but a normal generative response is not an independently inspectable chain of evidence.
explainability.uncertainty: Optional source/verification features were not tested; explanations are not treated as faithful internal model reasoning.

provenance_notes: AI-assisted documentation review, 2026-10-18; no live product tests. Scope: ordinary Gemini text chat without Connected Apps, Gems, research agents or device actions. Scores are design estimates. Sources: https://support.google.com/gemini/answer/13275745?hl=en and https://support.google.com/gemini/answer/16275805?hl=en .
